```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(c("R/read_data.R", "R/remove_future_observations.R"),
     ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

if (!exists("trigger_5min_wide"))
  trigger_5min_wide <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_5min(format = "wide", only_mean = TRUE))

# Variable order shared by all matrices.
variables <- c(
  "pm1", "pm25", "pm10",
  "pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10",
  "temperature", "humidity", "pressure", "sound", "light", "uvb",
  "step", "cal",
  "heartrate", "breathrate", "oxygens",
  "bodytemp", "skintemp", "bphigh", "bplow"
)
```

## Co-occurrence

Number of participant–five-minute buckets with both measurements available. Diagonal cells show availability for each measurement.

```{r}
observed <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  as.matrix() |>
  is.finite()

cooccurrence_matrix <- crossprod(observed * 1)

cooccurrence <- cooccurrence_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(
    -variable_1,
    names_to = "variable_2",
    values_to = "buckets_n") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables))

rm(observed)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(cooccurrence, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = buckets_n)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.1,
      scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
    )(buckets_n)),
    size = 2.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    trans = "sqrt",
    begin = 0.35,
    end = 0.95,
    labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Paired buckets") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```


## Correlations Spearman

Pooled Spearman correlations between five-minute means, using pairwise complete observations.

```{r}
sp_correlation_matrix <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  cor(method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

sp_correlations_long <- sp_correlation_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable_1, names_to = "variable_2", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(sp_correlations_long, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman ρ") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank())
```

## Correlations Pearson

Pooled Pearson correlations between five-minute means, using pairwise complete observations.

```{r}
pe_correlation_matrix <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  cor(method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

pe_correlation_long <- pe_correlation_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable_1, names_to = "variable_2", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(pe_correlation_long, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Pearson r") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
log_variables <- c(
  "pm1", "pm25", "pm10",
  "pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10",
  "light", "step", "cal"
)

pe_correlation_log_matrix <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(log_variables), log1p)) |>
  cor(method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

pe_correlation_log_long <- pe_correlation_log_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable_1, names_to = "variable_2", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(pe_correlation_log_long, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Pearson r (logp1)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank())
```


```{r}
comparison <- sp_correlations_long %>% rename(spearman = rho) %>%
  left_join(pe_correlation_long %>% rename(pearson = rho),
            by = join_by(variable_1, variable_2)) %>%
  left_join(pe_correlation_log_long %>% rename(log_pearson = rho),
            by = join_by(variable_1, variable_2)) %>%
  filter(as.character(variable_1) > as.character(variable_2),
                     xor(variable_1 %in% log_variables, variable_2 %in% log_variables)) %>%
  mutate(diff_pearson = abs(spearman - pearson),
         diff_logpearson = abs(spearman - log_pearson))
```

```{r}
ggplot(comparison, aes(x = diff_pearson, y = diff_logpearson)) + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(colour = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.65, size = 2) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "|Pearson − Spearman|: original data",
    y = "|Pearson − Spearman|: log-transformed data",
    caption = "Each point represents one variable pair. Points below the dashed line indicate closer agreement after transformation."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Particulate matter PCA

PCA of log-transformed, standardized PM/PC measurements, using complete five-minute buckets.

```{r}
particle_variables <- c(
  "pm1", "pm25", "pm10",
  "pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10"
)

particle_data <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(userId, bucket_5min, all_of(particle_variables)) |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(particle_variables), ~ is.finite(.x) & .x >= 0)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(particle_variables), log1p))

particle_pca <- particle_data |>
  select(all_of(particle_variables)) |>
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

tibble(
  buckets_n = nrow(particle_data),
  participants_n = n_distinct(particle_data$userId)
)
```

### Explained variance

```{r}
particle_variance <- tibble(
  component = factor(
    paste0("PC", seq_along(particle_pca$sdev)),
    levels = paste0("PC", seq_along(particle_pca$sdev))
  ),
  variance = particle_pca$sdev^2 / sum(particle_pca$sdev^2)
) |>
  mutate(cumulative = cumsum(variance))

particle_variance
```

### Component loadings

Weights of each measurement in the first three components.

```{r}
particle_loadings <- particle_pca$rotation |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable") |>
  pivot_longer(c(PC1, PC2, PC3),
               names_to = "component", values_to = "loading") |>
  select(variable, component, loading) |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(particle_variables)))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(particle_loadings, aes(loading, variable, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ component, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Hourly and daily redundancy

Separate PCAs of log-transformed, standardized PM/PC measurements.

```{r}
if (!exists("trigger_hour_wide"))
  trigger_hour_wide <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_hourly(format = "wide", only_mean = TRUE, min_5min = 4))

if (!exists("trigger_day_wide"))
  trigger_day_wide <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_daily(format = "wide", only_mean = TRUE,
                       min_hours = 16, min_5min = 3))
```

### Particulate matter PCA

```{r}
particle_pcas <- list(
  `5 min` = particle_pca,
  Hourly = trigger_hour_wide |>
    select(all_of(particle_variables)) |>
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ is.finite(.x) & .x >= 0)) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), log1p)) |>
    prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE),
  Daily = trigger_day_wide |>
    select(all_of(particle_variables)) |>
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ is.finite(.x) & .x >= 0)) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), log1p)) |>
    prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
)

variance_comparison <- imap_dfr(particle_pcas, \(pca, resolution) {
  tibble(
    resolution = resolution,
    component = paste0("PC", seq_along(pca$sdev)),
    variance = pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  ) |>
    mutate(cumulative = cumsum(variance))
}) |>
  mutate(resolution = factor(resolution, levels = names(particle_pcas)))

variance_comparison |>
  filter(component %in% c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(variance_comparison, aes(component, variance, fill = resolution)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ resolution, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Explained variance") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Component loadings

Component signs are aligned with the five-minute PCA for comparison.

```{r}
loadings_comparison <- imap_dfr(particle_pcas, \(pca, resolution) {
  weights <- pca$rotation[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  reference <- particle_pca$rotation[rownames(weights), 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  direction <- ifelse(colSums(weights * reference) < 0, -1, 1)

  sweep(weights, 2, direction, "*") |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "variable") |>
    pivot_longer(-variable, names_to = "component", values_to = "loading") |>
    mutate(resolution = resolution)
}) |>
  mutate(
    resolution = factor(resolution, levels = names(particle_pcas)),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(particle_variables))
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(loadings_comparison, aes(loading, variable, fill = resolution)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(component ~ resolution) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Steps and calories

Correlations between mean step and calorie measurements at each resolution.

```{r}
activity_correlations <- imap_dfr(
  list(`5 min` = trigger_5min_wide,
       Hourly = trigger_hour_wide,
       Daily = trigger_day_wide),
  \(data, resolution) {
    paired <- data |>
      select(step, cal) |>
      filter(if_all(everything(), ~ is.finite(.x) & .x >= 0))

    tibble(
      resolution = resolution,
      paired_n = nrow(paired),
      pearson = cor(paired$step, paired$cal),
      pearson_log = cor(log1p(paired$step), log1p(paired$cal)),
      spearman = cor(paired$step, paired$cal, method = "spearman")
    )
  }
)

activity_correlations |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```
